name: Redirect Preflight
buyer: Owner or project lead of a small web agency
trigger: A site migration redirect map is ready for review before staging is configured
inputs: CSV with old_url,new_url,status columns and absolute HTTP(S) URLs
Optional old URL inventory, one absolute URL per line
accepted_output: Row-numbered conflicts, duplicates, loops, chains, and uncovered inventory report plus reviewed mapping CSV
purchase_reason: One project pass for an occasional migration; repeat only for a new migration
decision_level: paid validation experiment via test-mode demo
channel_hypothesis: Public useful migration sample and opt-in agency discovery; access unproven
acceptance_criteria: Known fixture flags conflict, duplicate, self redirect, cycle, chain and missing inventory with row numbers
Malformed CSV and unsafe URL schemes are rejected with actionable errors
Free tier accepts 100 mappings; larger maps require a confirmed test purchase and are capped at 5000
Reviewed export omits sources with blocking issues and includes explicit offline limitations
Checkout cancellation or failed/unpaid session never grants entitlement; repeated fulfillment is idempotent
kill_conditions: Three unrelated agency buyers cannot be recruited or decline a 19 USD project pass
Existing tools or spreadsheets produce accepted deliverable as quickly
Median support exceeds 15 minutes per project or total weekly operations exceed five hours
